description: LiDAR -> vehicle (radar) frame per mounting: p_vehicle = Rz(yaw_deg) * p_lidar + (tx_m, ty_m). Read by perception/core/extrinsic.py. Sessions before the first valid_from use identity.

mountings.z_note: z is not shifted (the radar has no elevation for stationary targets; the LiDAR detector measures its own ground)
mountings.method: 2D rigid fit of the LiDAR corner-reflector position (background-subtracted) to the 13 nominal positions of calibration_dataset 2026-11-03 (2/3/5/8 m; names read from the reflector's side, *_left = vehicle right); residual 0.11 m mean, 0.33 m max. Radar on boresight agrees within +-3 deg; the team's manual fit (manual_calibration_result.yaml, not accepted_for_use) gives 38.6 deg.
mountings.provisional: until the team's extrinsic calibration is accepted
